evidence.quote: We propose a $38 million class fund distributed automatically to identified members, plus $7 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses
We cannot agree to a $45 million total outlay. We can offer $30 million for the class, paid automatically, plus up to $5 million
This brings the total proposed outlay to $39 million.
I do not represent that fees were discussed only after class relief was agreed.

summary: Hargrove first raised fees in its opening proposal, and the parties negotiated fees and class relief together before the final class fund was agreed. The transcript explicitly treats the class fund and fees as part of a combined total outlay, supporting fee-relief linkage. There is no clear evidence that class counsel prioritized its own fees over the class, that defense exploited fee interests, that reverse-auction tactics occurred, or that the court declaration was misleading.
